signal: Teamworks raised $235M at a $1.3B valuation in its Series F and acquired Opteamal and Sportlogiq, aggressively expanding its AI-powered athlete operations footprint.

email.body1:
Derek, saw Teamworks raised its $235M Series F at a $1.3B valuation and is buying up companies like Sportlogiq.

Scaling that fast usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before the new motion settles, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Teamworks off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Derek, quick follow-up for Teamworks.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Teamworks needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Derek, last bit of proof for Teamworks.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Teamworks' reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Derek, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a raise, timing is everything, and the fundraise-to-integration stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Teamworks' motion? I will tailor it to you either way.
